powers.name: Dry up water

params.text: turns a cube of water into a pellet

powers.text: It turns a cube of water into a pellet. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: A pinch dries up a 15-ft cube of water into a pellet, or ravages a creature made of water (10d6 Necrotic).
text: The packet holds 1d6 + 4 pinches. Sprinkling a pinch over water is a Utilize action that shrinks a 15-foot cube of water into a single marble-sized pellet of negligible weight, which floats or sits near the spot. Smashing the pellet on something hard (a Utilize action anyone can take) shatters it, releasing all the absorbed water and ending that pellet's magic. An Elemental formed mostly of water that a pinch touches must attempt a Constitution saving throw (DC 13), suffering 10d6 Necrotic damage if it fails or half that if it succeeds.
